title: Temple Construction Begins

questions.question: Where did Solomon began to build the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:1 (ESV): "Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah..."

questions.question: Whose threshing floor was at the site?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:1 (ESV): "...on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite."

questions.question: When did Solomon begin to build?
options: In the second month of the fourth year of his reign
questions.correctAnswer: In the second month of the fourth year of his reign
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:2 (ESV): "He began to build in the second month of the fourth year of his reign."

questions.question: What was carved on the walls of the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:7 (ESV): "...and he carved cherubim on the walls."

questions.question: What names were given to the two pillars?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:17 (ESV): "He set up the pillars... and called the name of the one on the south Jachin, and the name of the one on the north Boaz."

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the foundation (in cubits)?
options: Sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: Sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:3 (ESV): "...The length... was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits."

questions.question: With what did he overlay the inside of the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:4 (ESV): "...He overlaid it on the inside with pure gold."

questions.question: What precious material adorned the house for beauty?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:6 (ESV): "He adorned the house with settings of precious stones for beauty..."

questions.question: Type of gold used for the temple?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:6 (ESV): "...The gold was gold of Parvaim."

questions.question: How high were the pillars?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:15 (ESV): "In front of the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits high..."

questions.question: How long was the wingspan of the cherubim combined?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:11 (ESV): "The wings of the cherubim together extended twenty cubits..."

questions.question: Which direction did the cherubim face?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:13 (ESV): "...and they stood on their feet, facing the nave."

questions.question: What was the veil made of?
options: Blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen
questions.correctAnswer: Blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:14 (ESV): "And he made the veil of blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen..."

questions.question: What was embroidered on the veil?
What decorated the tops of the pillars?
options: Chains like a necklace and pomegranates
questions.correctAnswer: Chains like a necklace and pomegranates
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:16 (ESV): "He made chains like a necklace and put them on the tops of the pillars, and he made a hundred pomegranates..."

key_verse_text: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to David his father...
